notes: Continued only my own independent audit. Used read-only pilot_source tools; no other auditor answers, delegation, shell commands or test execution.

All four check_bindings results recomputed 478 declarations without span errors and matched receiver digest 0f103474ab338af1e51d5ca27366599c6270aeab066950dd05fe694bb5dc1471 and archive digest 5ea3cd76e2058563ca5311dcc50707e78df5fd04bcb0ce84255ccbd3d0c8be4b. Exact binding hashes are recorded per certificate. Reinspected certificate_spans.go: declaration spans use original bytes from scanner.GetTokenPosOfNode(n,f,false) to n.End(), qualified declaration keys and duplicate-key ambiguity rejection. Binding establishes attribution, not truth.

Inspected complete changed golang_cert_driver.go, golang_cert_pilot.go and emitted-main.go. Raw file/config/dependency fields now use []byte; JSON base64 transport and byte/string conversion preserve the retained bytes, including invalid UTF-8 and NUL. Each attempt receives the same retained serialized snapshot. Runtime str subsequently converts text to UTF-16 through runes; both children perform that same conversion. Raw retention does not assert that parser text preserves invalid UTF-8 verbatim.

Inspected original objects/Interface.getSequencedFiles, its getMainABAPFile source and emitted-hir.go:401880-401938. It returns an empty or freshly allocated single-file array and adds no writer or alias to the four caches. Its retention exception is in Go pilot coverage. Checked injection FuncDecl/StructType assertions fail explicitly on mismatches; pre-store semantics are unchanged.

No uncovered envelope remains for these four conditional cache-stability claims. Every provided precondition is retained. These attestations do not establish loop purity, input ownership, whole-loop virtual-receiver completeness, general lowering equivalence or parallelism safety. Successful warm-up is required; tests were inspected only.
